keyFindings.description: With no placement (every cross-block selection, every held send older than the placement field) every reading counts as surrounded, so two readings answer 'ambiguous', whose sentence (margin-context.tsx:106-107) says they read 'with the same text around them'. The PR's own unit row at record-mark-retype.test.ts:764 (`${QUOTE}, and ${QUOTE}.`) has different text around each. Item 4's rule broken again. The doc comments at :56-58, :106-111 and margin-context.tsx:96-100 describe only the in-block producer and say 'four'.

The merge 4d1f4d93 left a jj conflict marker ('>>>>>>> conflict 1 of 1 ends') in the API reference. Not on main, not at 50a3a587. The ANCHOR_MISSING entry at :2430 also fails scripts/semantic-line-breaks.ts (R1).
The doc says a composer's Retry is this one body. The composer builds its own request (MentionComposer.tsx:959-967). The boolean return is read by no caller.

useMargin() in every MentionComposer re-renders the conversation-tab and agent composers on every hover, selection and placement change of the margin context. registerComposer never changes, so it can have a context of its own.

A count-0 report whose IndexedDB count was read just before the re-mark's row was added (an unrelated edit's acknowledgement in the same milliseconds) answers the wait. Tag reports with the last ordinal they counted.
The block text that the count/choice invariant rests on is read by three hand-kept copies (:324, :383, :418). Use one textOf(block).
While the reader's own document is still loading (bridge not yet bound after a reload resumes a send), the refusal says the document 'is not open'.
abf83df6 re-indented main's inline script and changed nothing else (diff -w empty). It is unrelated to the fix. Revert it.
